overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the "Member Issues" agenda item was for proposing future topics, so the Board's informal poll on a zoning-maps topic did not require a separate notice listing. Suggested a more descriptive title.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board voted on a zoning-maps topic at its December 8, 2014 meeting even though the topic was not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: The informal vote that the Chair conducted was to discern whether there was enough interest in the topic for her to add it to the notice for a January meeting.
